verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's docs describe saving a skill and rerunning it on a schedule, with a concrete recurring routine example ("Every weekday at 8:00 AM") and event-triggered routines. Bots run on a persistent cloud computer while your laptop is closed, and results come back to a chat thread you can review on phone or desktop. A month-long user independently confirms that each bot owns its own routines and that async work actually works. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off (single future-time) scheduling, and documentation of how completed scheduled runs notify or deliver results to the user.
